title: Warp.Adapters.Webhooks — durable outbound webhook delivery (host owns subscriptions, Warp owns delivery)
public_contracts: Entity: warp.WebhookDelivery (always in schema; attempts = AdapterCallLog via CorrelationId — no attempt table)

success_criteria.description: SendAsync persists self-contained delivery; RetrySchedule converter roundtrips empty/single/multi-hour on both providers
Success ⇒ Delivered; AdapterCallLog attempt row with CorrelationId=deliveryId, operation=eventType, group; executor job completes (no failed jobs)
Failure with retries left ⇒ Pending, AttemptCount++, NextAttemptAt=schedule[N-1], Scheduled executor job with matching ScheduleTime
Exhaustion ⇒ Exhausted + exhausted-handler invoked once; [] schedule = single attempt
SuccessCodes honored (default any 2xx; explicit [200] fails a 202)
StandardWebhooks signing matches published test vector; None adds nothing; Custom uses registered signer
Redeliver resets Delivered/Exhausted to Pending + immediate attempt; Pending redeliver rejected
Query service filters (status/eventType/reference/group/date); endpoints + addons flag
Solution builds analyzer-clean with new project
Frontend builds with Webhooks pages + demo fixtures

out_of_scope: Subscription/registration modeling and fan-out (host-owned by design)
Automatic endpoint disabling (host decides via IWebhookDeliveryExhaustedHandler)
Per-endpoint keyed rate limiting of deliveries (extension of adapters shared limiter — deferred)
Migration tooling for legacy hand-rolled delivery tables
Any change to the worker fetch/execute hot path
assumptions: [ASSUMED] Standard Webhooks published test vectors suffice to verify signer correctness; validate in batch 3
[VERIFIED:docs/specs/2026-07-09-warp-adapters.md] adapters v1 provides CorrelationId, groups, RecordCalls, per-adapter CallLogRetention
risks: Secrets at rest on delivery rows — accepted for self-containment; redacted on all read surfaces; Signing=None escape hatch documented
Attempt and delivery rows expire independently (no FK cascade); default retention alignment mitigates
Retry timing precision = delay + up to ~5s activation + worker pickup; documented
Adoption prerequisite: a Warp server (worker) must run somewhere; Hangfire coexistence documented
trap: see Rejected alternatives in the .md spec

implement.behavioral_diff: New Warp.Adapters.Webhooks addon: IWebhookDispatcher.SendAsync persists a self-contained WebhookDelivery (per-send retry schedule as seconds-array, headers, payload, signing mode+secret, success codes, group, host Reference) and enqueues an always-completing executor job on warp:webhooks; attempts POST through an auto-registered warp-webhooks adapter (rows correlated by delivery id), retries ride Scheduled jobs (no timers/scans), exhaustion invokes the host callback once, redelivery resets settled deliveries with an immediate job. Standard Webhooks header signing (webhook-id=EventId stable across retries), None for legacy body-signing hosts, Custom via registered signer validated at AddWebhooks. Dashboard gains gated Webhooks nav, deliveries list+detail with attempt timeline and Redeliver, summary endpoint, demo mode. One new always-in-schema table.
